newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's may cut Kirin financial unit debt rating.
newsitem.headline: Moody's may cut Kirin financial unit debt rating.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Friday that it had placed the long-term debt rating of a financial unit of Kirin Brewery Co Ltd under review for possible downgrade.

Under review are the Aa1 ratings for a $500 million euro medium-term note programme and 10 billion yen worth of senior unsecured notes due November 2000 issued by Kirin International Finance (Netherlands) B.V. under an agreement with Kirin, Moody's said in a statement.
The financial unit is a wholly owned subsidiary of Kirin.
